prompt:
Our trading platform team needs a security health check before the upcoming regulatory review next week. We have an AI tool stack installed on this machine and we need three things:

1. A full fleet-wide security scan of all installed tools, saved as `fleet_audit.json`.

2. A deep-dive security assessment of the `quant-engine` component specifically — this one handles real money so it needs the full trust certification treatment — saved as `quant_engine_audit.json`.

3. A single consolidated summary file called `consolidated_audit.json` that brings together the key findings from both of the above reports so the compliance officer has one document to review.

The audit tooling is already installed on the machine. Please figure out how to run it correctly and produce all three output files in the workspace.
